name: team_bench
caption:
IF OUR BENCH WAS POKÉMON 🎮🏀

🎁 Jamal Shead = Delibird: spends all day delivering food to others. 7.0 assists a night through 10 games
🐒 Kyle Anderson = Passimian: its techniques pass from the boss to the group. 1.3 assists in 7 minutes a night in his 7 games
🥋 Trayce Jackson-Davis = Makuhita: knock it down and it keeps getting up. 70.6% from the field in his 9 games
🌪️ Jamison Battle = Kingdra: its ability is Sniper, and it causes tornadoes when it wakes. 42.9% from three through 10 games
🐻 Collin Murray-Boyles = Bewear: tremendous strength, hugs its companions. 10.7 points a night in his 9 games

That's a team we're taking into any gym in the league. Who would you change? 👇
